name: antirion
tagline: Open-source AI gateway that routes and manages LLM calls
description: Antirion is an open-source AI gateway written in Rust. It runs as a single binary with an embedded admin console and can be deployed on Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, or as a self‑hosted service. The gateway translates between OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock and any compatible server, allowing existing SDKs and tools to call any provider by changing the base URL. It provides routing, retries, rate limits, budgets, guardrails, logging and caching for every LLM request, all without a paid tier.
best_for: Routing LLM calls across multiple providers
Applying rate limits and spending budgets
Adding guardrails such as PII redaction
Running an AI gateway within your own infrastructure
